acct.title: Accounting
acct.not_started: The books have not started — enter the opening balances (cash, banks, debts) first. Until then nothing is posted.
acct.gl_hint: Type the code (e.g. 1010) to see every transaction with the running balance
acct.fy_fixed: Fixed — a year has been closed
acct.close_hint: Income and expense accounts are reset and the net result moves to retained earnings; balance sheet accounts carry forward. The books lock through that day.
acct.close_wait: The year has not ended yet
acct.stock_value: Stock value (only when the inventory module does not hold it)
acct.rate_note: Riel at {{rate}}៛ = $1 (rate on the last day)
acct.code_hint: 4–6 digits (1 assets · 2 liabilities · 3 equity · 4 income · 5-6 expenses)
acct.system_hint: System account: can be renamed, never deleted or switched off
acct.used_hint: Already used: code and type stay
acct.auto_hint: Automatic entry: correct it at its source (void the invoice / payment …)

tx_hint.expense: Fuel, rent, electricity, phone … paid now or on credit
tx_hint.purchase: Tools, a vehicle or other things (not stock — stock is bought on the Stock page)
tx_hint.supplier_payment: Pay back what was bought on credit
tx_hint.owner_contribution: The owner puts money into the company
tx_hint.owner_withdrawal: The owner takes money out for personal use
tx_hint.transfer: Cash into the bank, cash out of the bank, or bank to bank

payroll.salaries_hint: Monthly base salary ($) — used when a new month's payroll is made

acct.lock_hint: Nothing can be posted on or before this date any more (manual or automatic).
acct.opening_hint: Count the cash and check the bank balances now. Unpaid invoices, stock and deposits already in the app are added automatically. Editable until you confirm.
acct.old_debts: Customers who owed before the app
acct.old_debts_hint: Each becomes an OB-… invoice that can be paid like any invoice (not counted as revenue)
acct.opening_done: The books have started · opening equity {{equity}} · open invoices {{n}}
acct.opening_confirm: Confirm the opening balances on {{date}}? After this they cannot be changed — mistakes are corrected with a journal entry only.
acct.opening_draft_saved: Saved — editable until you press «Confirm opening balances»
acct.opening_draft_note: Draft — nothing is in the books until you press «Confirm opening balances»
